adele: Quick design check — proposing a "micro" breadcrumb strip above the canvas that only shows 2 levels by default (org > workspace) and a chevron to expand the full path. Goal: reduce visual noise for new users but keep deep-link clarity. Sketch: https://figma.com/proto/console-micro-crumbs

liam: I like the reduce-noise angle but how does that interact with shared links? If someone shares `/org/123/workspaces/456/models/789` will the stripped view still highlight the model?

tina: Router rule: URLs are canonical. The micro strip is purely presentational. When a full path is loaded we should auto-expand the strip to reveal the focused entity. If user then collapses it, store that as UI state only.

marta: Accessibility note: collapsing/expanding crumbs must be keyboard operable and we need to ensure screen readers hear context. Use `aria-expanded` on the chevron and announce opened/closed with `aria-live="polite"`. Also add `aria-current="page"` to the focused crumb.

jon: Implementation gotcha — animated expand causes focus to shift on screen readers in Safari. We should support `prefers-reduced-motion` and use instant reveal for assistive tech or when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set.

adele: Good point. We'll default to animated for heavy canvases but respect `reduced-motion`. Also thinking about deep links to subpanels: prefer nested paths like `/models/789/metrics` over fragments. Fragments (`#metrics`) break some mobile browsers on back/forward.

liam: On mobile/compact the micro crumb strip may not have room. Suggest a single-line truncated crumb with a popover that lists the full path. Needs to be reachable by keyboard and touch.

tina: Redirect policy: legacy query params we still see in telemetry: `?tab=overview`, `?panel=results`. I'll create a redirect map in the router to translate old -> new patterns. Example mapping: `?tab=overview` -> `/models/:id/overview`.

accessibility-bot: Auto-check: recommended additions -> ensure skip link exists, add focus-visible styles for crumbs, ensure popover is aria-modal=false and managed with roving tabindex if keyboard arrow navigation provided.

marta: Copy nits: change crumb separator to visually-muted chevrons (›) and not slashes. Also add a tooltip on hover with full path for truncated crumbs.

jon: QA note: need tests for back/forward navigation when user toggles rail collapse + expands a crumb. Save rail collapse in local prefs and allow `?rail=collapsed` override for permalinks shared in docs.

adele: Proposed decisions from this sync:
1) URLs remain canonical source of truth. UI may collapse/strip crumbs but router resolves full path on load.
2) Use nested paths for subviews (`/models/:id/metrics`) not hashes.
3) Micro-crumb: default two visible levels with expand control; expand auto-opens on deep-link load.
4) Accessibility: `aria-expanded`, `aria-current`, `aria-live`, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, visible focus ring, and a skip-to-main link.
5) Mobile: single-line truncated crumb with accessible popover listing the chain.
6) Router: add redirect mapping for known legacy query params and support `?rail=collapsed` flag.

liam: +1 on decisions, will add router tickets.

marta: :raised_hand: will validate with screen reader and mobile.

adele: I'll draft a short RFC and include a redirect table and an a11y checklist. Posting PR for the micro-crumb component next week. Thanks everyone!
